meta.name: description
meta.content: PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak dalam jasa pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, alat berat, dan multiguna terpercaya di Indonesia.

Miliki mobil impian Anda bersama IMFI! Kami menyediakan solusi pembiayaan untuk mobil baru maupun mobil bekas dengan proses pengajuan yang mudah, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, serta didukung layanan profesional di seluruh Indonesia. Baik untuk kebutuhan pribadi maupun usaha, IMFI siap menjadi mitra terpercaya dalam membantu Anda memiliki kendaraan sesuai kebutuhan dan kemampuan finansial.


MOBIL BARU

Miliki Mobil Impian dengan Pembiayaan yang Mudah dan Fleksibel


﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Saatnya mewujudkan impian memiliki mobil baru bersama IMFI. Kami menyediakan solusi pembiayaan untuk berbagai merek kendaraan, termasuk brand di bawah Indomobil Group seperti GAC Aion, Changan, Citroën, Maxus, dan VW, serta berbagai merek ternama lainnya. Dengan proses pengajuan yang mudah, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, serta didukung jaringan layanan yang luas, IMFI siap membantu Anda memiliki kendaraan sesuai kebutuhan, baik untuk penggunaan pribadi maupun usaha.


Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya untuk memberikan pengalaman pembiayaan yang nyaman. Tersedia pilihan tenor hingga 60 bulan, didukung suku bunga yang kompetitif sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, perlindungan Asuransi Kendaraan Bermotor, serta pilihan pembiayaan konvensional maupun syariah. Seluruh layanan didukung oleh jaringan kantor cabang IMFI di berbagai wilayah Indonesia, sehingga memudahkan Anda memperoleh layanan di setiap tahap pembiayaan. Pembiayaan mobil baru juga dapat diajukan menggunakan prinsip Syariah.


MOBIL BEKAS

Miliki Mobil Bekas Berkualitas dengan Pembiayaan yang Aman dan Terpercaya


Memiliki mobil bekas berkualitas kini semakin mudah bersama IMFI. Kami menyediakan solusi pembiayaan untuk berbagai merek dan tipe mobil bekas dengan proses pengajuan yang praktis, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, serta didukung jaringan layanan yang luas. Baik untuk kebutuhan pribadi maupun usaha, IMFI siap membantu Anda memiliki kendaraan yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan kemampuan finansial.


Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya untuk memberikan pengalaman pembiayaan yang nyaman. Tersedia pilihan tenor hingga 60 bulan, didukung suku bunga yang kompetitif sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, perlindungan Asuransi Kendaraan Bermotor, serta jaringan kantor cabang IMFI di berbagai wilayah Indonesia yang siap memberikan kemudahan layanan selama masa pembiayaan. Pembiayaan mobil bekas juga dapat diajukan menggunakan prinsip Syariah.

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿

Cek Persyaratan

Klik untuk Terhubung ke WhatsApp Kami


","desc_en":"

Own your dream car with IMFI. We provide financing solutions for both new and used cars through a simple application process, flexible financing tenors, and professional services supported by our nationwide branch network across Indonesia. Whether for personal or business needs, IMFI is your trusted financing partner, helping you own the right vehicle that suits your needs and financial capabilities.


NEW CARS

Own Your Dream Car with Easy and Flexible Financing

It's time to make your dream of owning a new car a reality with IMFI. We offer financing solutions for a wide range of vehicle brands, including brands under the Indomobil Group such as GAC Aion, Changan, Citroën, Maxus, and Volkswagen (VW), as well as many other leading automotive brands. With a simple application process, flexible financing tenors, and extensive service coverage, IMFI is ready to help you own the vehicle that best fits your needs, whether for personal or business use.


Backed by extensive experience in the financing industry, IMFI delivers financing services that are secure, transparent, and reliable, ensuring a smooth and comfortable financing experience. We offer financing tenors of up to 60 months, competitive interest rates in accordance with applicable terms and conditions, Motor Vehicle Insurance protection, and both conventional and Sharia financing options. Our services are supported by IMFI's extensive branch network throughout Indonesia, making it easy for you to access assistance at every stage of your financing journey. New car financing is also available under Sharia principles.


USED CARS

Own a Quality Used Car with Safe and Reliable Financing

Owning a quality used car is now easier than ever with IMFI. We provide financing solutions for a wide range of used car brands and models through a simple application process, flexible financing tenors, and comprehensive service coverage. Whether for personal or business purposes, IMFI is ready to help you own a vehicle that matches both your needs and financial capabilities.


With years of experience in the financing industry, IMFI offers secure, transparent, and reliable financing services to ensure a convenient financing experience. Financing tenors of up to 60 months are available, supported by competitive interest rates in accordance with applicable terms and conditions, Motor Vehicle Insurance protection, and IMFI's nationwide branch network, providing convenient support throughout your financing period. Used car financing is also available under Sharia principles.


Check the Requirement

Click to Chat with Us on WhatsApp

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿

","simulation_type":"DP"},{"id":7,"order":2,"slug":"motorcycle","code":"R2-AMU","is_syariah":false,"is_non_syariah":true,"image":"uploads/categories/idf8rEu3We4MvyEXowEMesthjymS81T62XgTGfPH.png","banner":"uploads/categories/banner/kbKurobl5InQIfr5pPrySAsvkoUDj6vMjLD8thpb.jpg","banner_title_id":"Pembiayaan Motor","banner_title_en":"Motorcycle FInancing","is_favorite":false,"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"is_single_page":false,"is_static":false,"is_product_descriptive":false,"created_at":"2025-10-27T03:26:34.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-07-14T17:47:19.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"name_id":"Motor","name_en":"Motorcycle","subtitle_id":"Pembiayaan motor baru","subtitle_en":"New motorcycle financing","desc_id":"

Miliki Motor Impian dengan Pembiayaan yang Mudah dan Fleksibel


Wujudkan impian memiliki motor bersama IMFI. Kami menyediakan solusi pembiayaan untuk motor baru maupun motor bekas dari berbagai merek ternama, termasuk brand di bawah Indomobil Group, yaitu Indomobil e-Motor, dan merek lain, seperti Honda, Yamaha, Vespa dan Kawasaki. Dengan proses pengajuan yang mudah, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, serta didukung jaringan layanan yang luas, IMFI siap membantu Anda memiliki kendaraan roda dua yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan, baik untuk mobilitas sehari-hari maupun aktivitas usaha.


Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya untuk memberikan pengalaman pembiayaan yang nyaman. Tersedia pilihan tenor hingga 48 bulan untuk motor baru dan hingga 36 bulan untuk motor bekas, didukung suku bunga yang kompetitif sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, perlindungan Asuransi Kendaraan Bermotor, serta pilihan pembiayaan konvensional maupun syariah untuk produk yang tersedia. Seluruh layanan juga didukung oleh jaringan kantor cabang IMFI di berbagai wilayah Indonesia, sehingga memudahkan Anda memperoleh layanan di setiap tahap pembiayaan. Pembiayaan motor juga dapat diajukan menggunakan prinsip Syariah.


Cek Persyaratan

Klik untuk Terhubung ke WhatsApp Kami


","desc_en":"

Own Your Dream Motorcycle with Easy and Flexible Financing


Make your dream of owning a motorcycle come true with IMFI. We provide financing solutions for both new and used motorcycles from various top brands, including brands under the Indomobil Group, such as Indomobil e-Motor, as well as other leading brands like Honda, Yamaha, Vespa, and Kawasaki. With a simple application process, flexible tenor options, and the support of an extensive service network, IMFI is ready to help you secure the two-wheeled vehicle that fits your needs, whether for daily mobility or business activities.


Backed by years of experience in the financing industry, IMFI delivers secure, transparent, and trusted services to ensure a convenient financing experience. We offer tenor options up to 48 months for new motorcycles and up to 36 months for used motorcycles, supported by competitive interest rates in accordance with applicable regulations. Our services also include motor vehicle insurance protection, as well as both conventional and Sharia financing options for available products. All services are supported by IMFI’s branch network across various regions in Indonesia, making it easy for you to access assistance at every stage of your financing. Motorcycle financing can also be applied for using Sharia principles.


Check the Requirement

Click to Chat with Us on WhatsApp


","simulation_type":"DP"},{"id":8,"order":3,"slug":"commercial-vehicle","code":"CV-Dutro","is_syariah":false,"is_non_syariah":true,"image":"uploads/categories/idoBX7qUt1noW0Rr2us1SWhPxqMJGJwMHtO18dpM.png","banner":"uploads/static-page/1Iy7D59DmF8ZEZLXb24bp9f5yiPox9QJsMC6UBIS.jpg","banner_title_id":"Pembiayaan Kendaraan Niaga","banner_title_en":"Financing of Commercial Vehicles","is_favorite":false,"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"is_single_page":false,"is_static":false,"is_product_descriptive":false,"created_at":"2025-10-27T03:27:00.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-31T10:08:09.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"name_id":"Kendaraan Niaga","name_en":"Commercial Vehicle","subtitle_id":"Pembiayaan Truk dan Kendaraan Niaga Lainnya","subtitle_en":"Financing of Trucks and Other Commercial Vehicles","desc_id":"

Dukung Produktivitas Bisnis dengan Pembiayaan Kendaraan Niaga yang Fleksibel 


Kembangkan bisnis Anda bersama IMFI melalui solusi pembiayaan kendaraan niaga yang dirancang untuk mendukung berbagai kebutuhan operasional usaha. Kami menyediakan pembiayaan untuk beragam kendaraan niaga, termasuk merek di bawah Indomobil Group seperti Hino dan JAC Motors, serta merek lainnya sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku. Dengan proses pengajuan yang praktis, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, dan didukung layanan profesional, IMFI siap menjadi mitra terpercaya dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis Anda.

Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya untuk memberikan kemudahan dalam pengadaan armada usaha. Tersedia pilihan tenor hingga 48 bulan, didukung suku bunga yang kompetitif sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, serta skema pembiayaan yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan bisnis Anda. Seluruh proses didukung oleh jaringan kantor cabang IMFI di berbagai wilayah Indonesia dan kerja sama dengan dealer resmi, sehingga memberikan kemudahan layanan dari proses pengajuan hingga realisasi pembiayaan. Pembiayaan kendaraan niaga juga dapat diajukan menggunakan prinsip Syariah.

Support Your Business Productivity with Flexible Commercial Vehicle Financing

Grow your business with IMFI through commercial vehicle financing solutions designed to support a wide range of operational needs. We provide financing for various types of commercial vehicles, including brands under the Indomobil Group such as Hino and JAC Motors, as well as other brands in accordance with applicable terms and conditions.

With a practical application process, flexible financing terms, and professional service, IMFI is ready to be your trusted partner in supporting your business growth.

Backed by our experience in the financing industry, IMFI provides secure, transparent, and reliable services to make it easier for businesses to acquire their fleets. Financing terms of up to 48 months are available, supported by competitive interest rates in accordance with applicable terms and conditions, as well as financing schemes tailored to your business needs.

The entire process is supported by IMFI's network of branch offices across Indonesia and partnerships with authorized dealers, providing convenient service from application through financing disbursement. Commercial vehicle financing is also available based on Sharia principles.

IMFI hadir sebagai mitra terpercaya untuk mendukung kebutuhan pembiayaan alat berat bagi berbagai sektor industri, seperti konstruksi, perkebunan, pertambangan, dan sektor produktif lainnya. Kami menyediakan solusi pembiayaan untuk berbagai jenis alat berat, termasuk excavator, traktor, dan unit lainnya, melalui kerja sama dengan merek-merek ternama seperti Volvo, John Deere, dan Renault. Dengan proses pengajuan yang praktis, pilihan tenor yang fleksibel, serta didukung layanan profesional, IMFI siap membantu Anda memperoleh alat berat yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan operasional bisnis.


Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya untuk mendukung pengembangan usaha Anda. Tersedia pilihan tenor hingga 36 bulan, didukung suku bunga yang kompetitif sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, serta skema pembiayaan yang dirancang untuk memenuhi kebutuhan bisnis. Seluruh proses didukung oleh tim yang berpengalaman dan jaringan layanan IMFI, sehingga memberikan kemudahan mulai dari proses pengajuan hingga realisasi pembiayaan.


Cek Persyaratan

Klik untuk Terhubung ke WhatsApp Kami


Konsultasi dengan Tim Kami

IMFI is your trusted financing partner, providing heavy equipment financing solutions to support a wide range of industries, including construction, plantations, mining, and other productive sectors. We offer financing for various types of heavy equipment, such as excavators, tractors, and other machinery, through partnerships with leading global brands including Volvo, John Deere, and Renault. With a simple application process, flexible financing terms, and professional customer service, IMFI is committed to helping businesses acquire the right equipment to support their operational needs.


With extensive experience in the financing industry, IMFI provides secure, transparent, and reliable financing solutions to support your business growth. We offer financing terms of up to 36 months, competitive interest rates in accordance with applicable regulations, and flexible financing schemes tailored to your business requirements. Every stage of the financing process is supported by our experienced team and IMFI's nationwide service network, ensuring a seamless experience from application to financing disbursement.

","simulation_type":"DP"},{"id":11,"order":6,"slug":"multipurpose-credit","code":"R4-AMU","is_syariah":false,"is_non_syariah":true,"image":"uploads/categories/KzIMBtkKXT6LjFUKxfExQYn1ehtVP3U1HJCj4nT0.png","banner":"uploads/categories/banner/0AMz7BO5FCyemiehbYehxxo58CyvhSjjr1AKircA.jpg","banner_title_id":"Fasilitas Dana Tunai","banner_title_en":"Cash Loan","is_favorite":false,"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"is_single_page":false,"is_static":false,"is_product_descriptive":false,"created_at":"2025-10-27T03:27:59.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-07-14T17:47:19.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"name_id":"Kredit Multiguna","name_en":"Multipurpose Credit","subtitle_id":"Pinjaman dana tunai berjaminan BPKB atau Sertifikat untuk berbagai kebutuhan","subtitle_en":"Financing with collateral for various needs","desc_id":"

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI) sebagai perusahaan pembiayaan yang andal dan terpercaya memberikan fasilitas Kredit Multiguna menggunakan jaminan BPKB kendaraan dan sertipikat kepemilikan rumah atau properti. Bagi Anda yang membutuhkan dana darurat untuk kebutuhan Anda, mulai dari biaya pendidikan, pernikahan, renovasi rumah, sampai biaya kesehatan, Anda bisa mengajukan pembiayaan dana tunai dengan jaminan BPKB kendaraan atau sertipikat properti melalui IMFI.


Fasilitas Dana Tunai Jaminan BPKB


Penuhi berbagai kebutuhan finansial secara mudah melalui Fasilitas Dana Tunai jaminan BPKB motor dan mobil dari IMFI. IMFI menyediakan pencairan dana tunai dengan plafon pokok pembiayaan hingga Rp500.000.000.

Keuntungan pinjaman dana tunai dengan jaminan BPKB Motor:

  • Suku bunga kompetitif 
  • Pilihan tenor pembiayaan fleksibel, mulai dari 12 bulan sampai dengan 36 bulan

Keuntungan pinjaman dana tunai dengan jaminan BPKB Mobil:

  • Suku bunga ringan
  • Pilihan tenor pembiayaan fleksibel, mulai dari 12 bulan sampai dengan 48 bulan


Fasilitas Dana Tunai Jaminan Sertipikat Properti


Penuhi berbagai kebutuhan dana tunai dalam jumlah besar, mulai dari biaya pendidikan, biaya kesehatan, sampai renovasi rumah, hanya di IMFI. 

Keuntungan pinjaman dana tunai jaminan sertipikat rumah atau apartemen :

  • Pencairan hingga 80% dari nilai properti
  • Bunga kompetitif
  • Bunga fixed sampai dengan 5 tahun

Sertipikat yang dapat dijaminkan berupa:

  • Sertipikat Hak Milik (SHM) rumah dan ruko 
  • Sertifikat Hak Guna Bangunan (SHGB)
  • Sertifikat Apartemen - Sertifikat Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun (SHMSRS)


Cek Persyaratan

Klik untuk Terhubung ke WhatsApp Kami


","desc_en":"

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI), a trusted and reliable financing company, offers Multi-Purpose Loan facilities secured by vehicle ownership certificates (BPKB) or residential and commercial property ownership certificates. Whether you need emergency funds for education expenses, wedding costs, home renovations, medical bills, or other personal financial needs, IMFI provides secure cash financing solutions with your vehicle BPKB or property certificate as collateral.


Cash Loan Facility Secured by Vehicle BPKB


Meet your financial needs with ease through IMFI's cash loan facility secured by your motorcycle or car BPKB. IMFI offers financing with loan amounts of up to IDR 500,000,000.

Benefits of Cash Loans Secured by Motorcycle BPKB

  • Competitive interest rates
  • Flexible financing terms ranging from 12 to 36 months

Benefits of Cash Loans Secured by Car BPKB

  • Competitive interest rates
  • Flexible financing terms ranging from 12 to 48 months


Cash Loan Facility Secured by Property Certificate


Access larger financing amounts to support various financial needs, including education expenses, medical costs, and home renovations, with IMFI's property-backed cash loan facility.

Benefits of Cash Loans Secured by a House or Apartment Certificate

  • Financing of up to 80% of the property's appraised value
  • Competitive interest rates
  • Fixed interest rates for up to five years

Eligible Property Certificates

  • Freehold Title Certificate (SHM) for houses and shophouses
  • Right-to-Build Certificate (SHGB)
  • Apartment Ownership Certificate (SHMSRS)

Dukung pertumbuhan usaha Anda bersama IMFI melalui solusi pembiayaan usaha mikro yang dirancang untuk membantu memenuhi kebutuhan modal kerja. Produk ini ditujukan bagi pelaku Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM), khususnya yang bergerak di bidang toko kelontong dan toko suku cadang kendaraan, agar dapat mengembangkan usaha, meningkatkan kapasitas operasional, dan memperluas peluang bisnis.


Berbekal pengalaman di industri pembiayaan, IMFI menghadirkan layanan yang aman, transparan, dan terpercaya dengan proses pengajuan yang praktis serta didukung layanan profesional. Pembiayaan usaha mikro tersedia dengan plafon pembiayaan hingga Rp20 juta sesuai hasil analisis kredit dan ketentuan yang berlaku, sehingga memberikan solusi yang tepat untuk mendukung perkembangan usaha Anda.


","desc_en":"

Support your business growth with IMFI's micro business financing solutions, designed to help meet your working capital needs. This financing product is intended for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (UMKM), particularly grocery stores and automotive spare parts retailers, enabling them to expand their businesses, enhance operational capacity, and seize new business opportunities.


With extensive experience in the financing industry, IMFI provides secure, transparent, and reliable financing solutions to support your business growth. Micro business financing is available with financing amounts of up to IDR 20 million, subject to credit assessment and applicable terms and conditions, providing the right financial support to help your business grow.

Konsumen dapat melakukan pembayaran secara autodebet ke rekening IMFI melalui tempat-tempat berikut ini:





Keterangan:

  1. Untuk pendaftaran autodebet dapat menghubungi kantor cabang terdekat
  2. Pastikan saldo Anda cukup untuk melakukan pembayaran melalui autodebet
","EN":"

Consumers can make payments via auto-debit to their IMFI account through the following channels:





Note:

  1. To register for auto-debit, please contact your nearest branch office.
  2. Ensure your balance is sufficient to make the auto-debit payment.

Keterangan:

  1. Masukan kartu ke mesin ATM
  2. Masukan No. PIN ATM
  3. Plih ‘Transaksi lainnya’
  4. Pilih ‘Transfer’
  5. Pilih ‘BCA Virtual Account’
  6. Masukan No. Rekening Anda yang terdiri dari kode perusahaan yaitu: 88770889900 + No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  7. Periksa kembali data anda dan total tagihan yang tertera di layar ATM (Total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  8. Tekan ‘Ya’ untuk melanjutkan ke proses pembayaran
  9. Masukan PIN
  10. ATM akan memproses pembayaran, dan mengeluarkan struk sebagai bukti pembayaran
  11. Simpan struk pembayaran Anda
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Insert your card into the ATM.
  2. Enter your ATM PIN.
  3. Select 'Other Transactions'.
  4. Select 'Transfer'.
  5. Select 'BCA Virtual Account'.
  6. Enter your account number, which includes the company code: 88770889900 + the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  7. Recheck your details and the total bill displayed on the ATM screen. (The total bill includes the admin fee.)
  8. Press 'Yes' to proceed with the payment process.
  9. Enter your PIN.
  10. The ATM will process the payment and issue a receipt as proof of payment.
  11. Save your receipt.

Keterangan:

  1. Masukan kartu ke mesin ATM,
  2. Masukan No. PIN ATM
  3. Pilih menu ‘Pembayaran/Pembelian’
  4. Pilih menu ‘Angsuran’
  5. Masukan kode perusahaan Indomobil Finance: 88020
  6. Masukan No. Mandiri Virtual Account, yaitu 88020 + No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  7. Masukan jumlah dana yang akan dibayar, lanjut tekan ‘Benar’
  8. Layar akan menampilkan konfirmasi pembayaran, tekan ‘Ya’ jika sudah benar
  9. ATM akan memproses pembayaran
  10. Simpan struk pembayaran
","EN":"


Instructions:

  1. Insert your card into the ATM.
  2. Enter your ATM PIN.
  3. Select the 'Payment/Purchase' menu.
  4. Select the 'Installment' menu.
  5. Enter the Indomobil Finance company code: 88020.
  6. Enter your Mandiri Virtual Account number, which is 88020 + the distance payment number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit distance payment number).
  7. Enter the amount to be paid, then press 'Correct'.
  8. The screen will display a payment confirmation. Press 'Yes' if the information is correct.
  9. The ATM will process the payment.
  10. Save the payment receipt.

Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi Livin by Mandiri di smartphone, kemudian pilih Login untuk akses masuk
  2. Input kode Password pada kolom, lalu pilih Login
  3. Pilih menu Bayar
  4. Ketik Payment Kita di kolom pencarian Cari Penyedia Jasa pada halaman menu Bayar, kolom menampilkan pilihan pembayaran baru Payment Kita
  5. Pilih kategori Payment Kita yang sudah muncul di kolom Penyedia Jasa, m-banking otomatis menampilkan halaman Payment Kita
  6. Input Kode Merchant dengan kode \"117\" pada halaman Payment Kita
  7. Input kolom ID Pelanggan dengan 10 digit nomor pembayaran yang terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 digit nomor PJJ pada halaman Payment Kita
  8. Pilih tombol Lanjutkan untuk proses pembentukan tagihan angsuran
  9. Periksa data tagihan, jika sudah benar dan sesuai pilih tanda (X) untuk keluar Pop-Up Detail Tagihan
  10. Pilih tombol Lanjutkan untuk proses pembayaran tagihan angsuran, untuk total tagihan yang muncul termasuk dengan biaya admin
  11. Simpan bukti transaksi pembayaran melalui m-Banking sebagai bukti pembayaran angsuran yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the Livin by Mandiri app on your smartphone, then select Login to access it.
  2. Enter your password in the field, then select Login.
  3. Select the Pay menu.
  4. Type \"Payment Kita\" in the \"Search for Service Providers\" search field on the \"Pay\" menu page. The field displays the new \"Payment Kita\" payment option.
  5. Select the \"Payment Kita\" category that appears in the \"Service Provider\" field. Mobile banking automatically displays the \"Payment Kita\" page.
  6. Enter the Merchant Code with the code \"117\" on the \"Payment Kita\" page.
  7. Enter the Customer ID field with the 10-digit payment number consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code and the 7-digit PJJ number on the \"Payment Kita\" page.
  8. Select the \"Continue\" button to create the installment bill.
  9. Check the billing details. If they are correct, select the \"X\" to exit the \"Bill Details\" pop-up.
  10. Select the \"Continue\" button to process the installment bill payment. The total bill includes the admin fee.
  11. Save proof of payment via mobile banking as valid proof of installment payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T12:53:00.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:38:36.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":27,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Mobile Banking (UOB TMRW)","EN":"MOBILE BANKING (UOB TMRW)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi m-banking UOB TMRW dan login
  2. Pilih menu ‘Top Up dan Tagihan’
  3. Pilih kategori ‘Cicilan’
  4. Ketik ‘Indomobil Finance’ pada kolom pencarian dan pilih ‘Indomobil Finance’ untuk memunculkan halaman ‘Top Up dan Tagihan’
  5. Masukkan nomor kontrak dengan no. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  6. Pilih ‘Lanjut’ untuk menampilkan data tagihan (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  7. Pilih ‘Lanjut’ untuk menampilkan halaman konfirmasi
  8. Geser tombol “Geser Untuk Konfirmasi” dan masukkan PIN m-banking untuk melakukan pembayaran
  9. Pembayaran selesai dan akan menampilkan resi pembayaran. Bukti bayar yang dikeluarkan Bank UOB adalah bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the UOB TMRW mobile banking app and log in.
  2. Select the 'Top Up and Bills' menu.
  3. Select the 'Installments' category.
  4. Type 'Indomobil Finance' in the search field and select 'Indomobil Finance' to display the 'Top Up and Bills' page.
  5. Enter the contract number with the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  6. Select 'Continue' to display the billing details (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  7. Select 'Continue' to display the confirmation page.
  8. Swipe the \"Swipe to Confirm\" button and enter your mobile banking PIN to make the payment. The payment is complete and a payment receipt will be displayed. The proof of payment issued by UOB Bank is valid proof of payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T12:57:57.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:38:22.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":28,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Internet Banking (BCA)","EN":"INTERNET BANKING (BCA)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Masukkan User ID dan Pin I-Banking Anda
  2. Pilih ‘Transfer Dana’
  3. Pilih ‘BCA Virtual Account’
  4. Masukan No. BCA Virtual Account, yaitu 88770889900 + No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  5. Klik ‘Ok’ jika sudah benar
  6. Periksa kembali data Anda dan total tagihan yang tertera di layar ATM (Total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  7. Klik ‘Ok’ untuk lanjut ke pembayaran
  8. Masukkan PIN/challenge kode token
  9. Simpan bukti/notifikasi pembayaran tersebut

Description:

  1. Enter your I-Banking User ID and PIN
  2. Select 'Fund Transfer'
  3. Select 'BCA Virtual Account'
  4. Enter your BCA Virtual Account Number, which is 88770889900 + PJJ Number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number)
  5. Click 'OK' if it's correct
  6. Recheck your details and the total bill displayed on the ATM screen (the total bill includes the admin fee)
  7. Click 'OK' to proceed with payment
  8. Enter your PIN/challenge token code
  9. Save the proof/payment notification

Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi Tokopedia pada gawai dan login ke dalam aplikasi
  2. Masuk atau daftarkan akun Tokopedia Anda (konsumen daftar dengan menggunakan email)
  3. Pilih kategori ‘Angsuran Kredit’
  4. Pilih penyedia pinjaman ‘Indomobil Finance’ lalu masukan No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  5. Klik ‘Beli’ Pastikan informasi tagihan sesuai
  6. Klik ‘Lanjut’
  7. Pilih metode pembayaran yang ingin digunakan.
  8. Klik ‘Bayar Sekarang’
  9. Bukti Pembayaran akan dikirim via email oleh Tokopedia
  10. Simpanlah bukti bayar sebagai bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the Tokopedia app on your device and log in.
  2. Log in or register your Tokopedia account (customers register using their email address).
  3. Select the 'Credit Installment' category.
  4. Select the 'Indomobil Finance' loan provider and enter your PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  5. Click 'Buy'. Ensure the billing information is correct.
  6. Click 'Continue'.
  7. Select your preferred payment method.
  8. Click 'Pay Now'.
  9. Proof of payment will be sent via email by Tokopedia.
  10. Save the proof of payment as valid proof of payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:10:59.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:37:57.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":null,"items":[]},{"id":30,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Online Payment (Shopee)","EN":"ONLINE PAYMENT (Shopee)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi Shopee pada gawai dan login ke dalam aplikasi
  2. Pilih menu “Pulsa, Tagihan & Hiburan”
  3. Pilih “Angsuran Kredit”
  4. Pilih penyedia pinjaman “Indomobil Finance”
  5. Masukan nomor kontrak di nomor pelanggan dengan no PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ), kemudian pilih tombol Lihat Tagihan
  6. Silahkan periksa data tagihan, apabila telah sesuai pilih tombol Lanjut (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  7. Pilih Metode Pembayaran Angsuran yang akan digunakan
  8. Pilih tombol Bayar Sekarang pada tampilan halaman checkout
  9. Pilih menu Lihat Rincian Pesanan
  10. Pilih tombol Download Struk Pembayaran dan simpan sebagai bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the Shopee app on your device and log in.
  2. Select the \"Credit, Bills & Entertainment\" menu.
  3. Select \"Credit Installments.\"
  4. Select the loan provider \"Indomobil Finance.\"
  5. Enter the contract number on your customer ID along with the distance learning number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit distance learning number), then select the View Bill button.
  6. Please review the billing details. If they are correct, select the Continue button (the total bill displayed includes the admin fee).
  7. Select the Installment Payment Method you wish to use.
  8. Select the Pay Now button on the checkout page.
  9. Select the View Order Details menu.
  10. Select the Download Payment Receipt button and save it as valid proof of payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:12:09.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:37:26.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":31,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Online Payment (OVO)","EN":"ONLINE PAYMENT (OVO)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi OVO pada gawai dan login ke dalam aplikasi
  2. Pilih menu “Angsuran Kredit”
  3. Pilih “Indomobil Finance”
  4. Masukan nomor pelanggan dengan no. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  5. Muncul informasi tagihan (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  6. Melakukan pembayaran angsuran dengan cara bayar yang tersedia
  7. Bukti bayar yang dikeluarkan OVO adalah bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the OVO app on your device and log in.
  2. Select the \"Credit Installment\" menu.
  3. Select \"Indomobil Finance.\"
  4. Enter your customer number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  5. Billing information will appear (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  6. Make your installment payment using the available payment methods.
  7. The proof of payment issued by OVO is valid proof of payment.

Konsumen dapat melakukan pembayaran secara tunai/non tunai ke rekening IMFI melalui tempat-tempat berikut ini:



Keterangan:

  1. Konsumen dapat melakukan pembayaran di gerai-gerai di atas dengan menyebutkan Nomor PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  2. Khusus pembayaran di Indomaret hanya untuk pembayaran angsuran maksimal Rp 5.000.000,-
  3. Biaya administrasi yang ditimbulkan merupakan tanggung jawab konsumen
  4. Untuk info No. PJJ* hubungi kantor cabang IMFI terdekat
","EN":"

Consumers can make cash or non-cash payments to IMFI accounts through the following locations:








Description:

  1. Consumers can make payments at the outlets above by providing their PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  2. Payments at Indomaret are only for installment payments up to IDR 5,000,000.
  3. The customer is responsible for any administrative fees incurred.
  4. For information on PJJ numbers*, contact the nearest IMFI branch office.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:15:28.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:37:03.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":33,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Virtual Account (Bank BRI)","EN":"VIRTUAL ACCOUNT (Bank brI)"},"content":{"ID":"



Keterangan:

  1. Masukkan kartu debit ke mesin ATM
  2. Masukkan PIN ATM
  3. Pilih ‘Transaksi lain’
  4. Pilih ‘Pembayaran’
  5. Pilih ‘Lainnya’
  6. Pilih ‘BRIVA’
  7. Masukkan nomor BRIVA Anda (15 digit) yaitu 77876 + No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  8. Masukkan jumlah dana yang akan dibayarkan
  9. Periksa kembali nama konsumen, nomor BRIVA, dan nilai pembayaran
  10. Apabila sudah sesuai, pilih ‘Ya’ untuk melanjutkan proses transaksi
  11. ATM akan memproses pembayaran, dan mengeluarkan struk sebagai bukti pembayaran
  12. Simpan struk pembayaran  
","EN":"



Description:

  1. Insert your debit card into the ATM.
  2. Enter your ATM PIN.
  3. Select 'Other Transactions'.
  4. Select 'Payment'.
  5. Select 'Other'.
  6. Select 'BRIVA'.
  7. Enter your BRIVA number (15 digits), which is 77876 + your PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  8. Enter the amount to be paid.
  9. Recheck the customer name, BRIVA number, and payment amount.
  10. If they are correct, select 'Yes' to continue the transaction.
  11. The ATM will process the payment and issue a receipt as proof of payment.
  12. Save the receipt.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:18:04.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:36:42.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":34,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Bank HSBC melalui ATM Bersama","EN":"Bank HSBC melalui ATM Bersama"},"content":{"ID":"



Keterangan:

  1. Masukan kartu ke mesin ATM
  2. Masukan No. Pin ATM
  3. Pilih ‘Transfer’ pada menu ATM
  4. Pilih ‘Transfer’ ke bank ATM Bersama/bank lain
  5. Masukan kode bank tujuan 087 + 8899 (R2) atau 8877 (R4) + No. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  6. Pilih ‘Benar’ untuk melanjutkan transaksi.
  7. Masukan jumlah dana yang akan di transfer, setelah itu pilih ‘Benar’
  8. Lewati layar referensi, pilih ‘Benar’
  9. Layar ATM akan memunculkan data transaksi yang akan diproses dengan nama PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia
  10. Pilih ‘Benar’ apabila data telah sesuai
  11. Simpan struk pembayaran
","EN":"



Description:

  1. Insert your card into the ATM.
  2. Enter your ATM PIN.
  3. Select 'Transfer' from the ATM menu.
  4. Select 'Transfer' to another ATM Bersama bank or other bank.
  5. Enter the destination bank code 087 + 8899 (R2) or 8877 (R4) + the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  6. Select 'Correct' to continue the transaction.
  7. Enter the amount to be transferred, then select 'Correct'.
  8. Skip the reference screen and select 'Correct'.
  9. The ATM screen will display the transaction data to be processed under the name PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia.
  10. Select 'Correct' if the data is correct.
  11. Save the payment receipt.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:20:09.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-12-05T23:07:13.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":35,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Mobile Banking (BRIMO)","EN":"MOBILE BANKING (BRIMO)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Masukkan Username dan Password BRIMO
  2. Pilih menu ‘Lainnya’
  3. Pilih menu ‘Cicilan’
  4. Pilih menu ‘Pembayaran Baru’
  5. Pilih menu ‘Jenis Cicilan’
  6. Pilih ‘Indomobil Finance’
  7. Masukkan nomor Pelanggan dengan nomor PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  8. Pada layar akan muncul halaman konfirmasi pembayaran (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  9. Pilih ‘Konfirmasi’
  10. Masukkan PIN
  11. Simpan bukti/notifikasi pembayaran Anda
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Enter your BRIMO username and password
  2. Select the 'Other' menu
  3. Select the 'Installments' menu
  4. Select the 'New Payment' menu
  5. Select the 'Installment Type' menu
  6. Select 'Indomobil Finance'
  7. Enter your customer number and the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number)
  8. A payment confirmation page will appear on the screen (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  9. Select 'Confirm'
  10. Enter your PIN
  11. Save your proof/payment notification
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:23:47.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:35:33.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":36,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Mobile Banking (BTN)","EN":"MOBILE BANKING (btn)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi m-banking BTN dan login
  2. Pilih menu ‘Pembayaran'
  3. Pilih kategori ‘Multibiller’
  4. Pilih rekening sumber yang akan digunakan untuk pembayaran angsuran
  5. Pilih ‘Opsi’ dengan ‘Pilih Institusi dan Masukan No Kontrak’
  6. Pilih ‘Institusi Multifinance’ dengan ‘Multifinance IMFI’
  7. Masukan nomor kontrak dengan nomor PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  8. Pilih ‘Kirim’ dan layar akan menampilkan data tagihan (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  9. Pilih ‘Lanjut’ dan layar akan menampilkan halaman konfirmasi
  10. Masukkan PIN dan m-token, kemudian pilih ‘Kirim’
  11. Pembayaran selesai dan layar akan menampilkan resi pembayaran. Bukti bayar yang dikeluarkan BTN adalah bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the BTN mobile banking application and log in.
  2. Select the 'Payment' menu.
  3. Select the 'Multibiller' category.
  4. Select the source account to be used for installment payments.
  5. Select 'Options' with 'Select Institution and Enter Contract Number'.
  6. Select 'Multifinance Institution' with 'IMFI Multifinance'.
  7. Enter the contract number with the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  8. Select 'Send' and the screen will display the billing details (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  9. Select 'Continue' and the screen will display the confirmation page.
  10. Enter your PIN and m-token, then select 'Send'.
  11. The payment is complete and the screen will display the payment receipt. The proof of payment issued by BTN is valid proof of payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:25:19.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:35:04.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":37,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Mobile Banking (CIMB Niaga - OCTO Mobile)","EN":"MOBILE BANKING (CIMB Niaga - OCTO Mobile)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi m-banking CIMB Niaga (OCTO Mobile) dan login
  2. Pilih menu ‘Pembayaran Tagihan’ 
  3. Pilih kategori ‘Pinjaman’
  4. Pilih Rekening Sumber yang akan digunakan untuk pembayaran angsuran
  5. Pilih jenis tagihan ‘Indomobil Finance Indonesia’
  6. Masukan nomor pinjaman dengan no. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ)
  7. Pilih ‘Lanjut’ untuk menampilkan Rincian Tagihan (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  8. Pilih ‘Konfirmasi’ dan masukan nomor PIN m-banking untuk melakukan pembayaran, kemudian klik tombol ‘Lanjut’
  9. Pembayaran selesai dan akan menampilkan resi pembayaran. Bukti bayar yang dikeluarkan bank CIMB Niaga adalah bukti bayar yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the CIMB Niaga mobile banking application (OCTO Mobile) and log in.
  2. Select the 'Bill Payment' menu.
  3. Select the 'Loan' category.
  4. Select the source account to be used for installment payments.
  5. Select the bill type 'Indomobil Finance Indonesia'.
  6. Enter the loan number with the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number).
  7. Select 'Continue' to display the Bill Details (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  8. Select 'Confirm' and enter your mobile banking PIN to make the payment, then click the 'Continue' button.
  9. The payment is complete and a payment receipt will be displayed. The proof of payment issued by CIMB Niaga Bank is valid proof of payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:26:56.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:34:45.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":38,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Internet Banking (i-Banking Bank Mandiri)","EN":"INTERNET BANKING (i-Banking Bank Mandiri)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka situs web i-Banking Bank Mandiri pada browser 
  2. Input User ID dan Password kemudian klik tombol Masuk untuk Login di i-Banking
  3. Pilih Menu Pembayaran - Multipayment
  4. Klik kolom Penyedia Jasa kemudian ketik kata pencarian Payment Kita, kolom menampilkan pilihan Payment Kita kemudian klik dan otomatis terisi \"Payment Kita\"
  5. Klik kolom Kode Merchant, halaman i-Banking otomatis menampilkan Konfirmasi Nama Pembayaran
  6. Input kode 117 di kolom Kode Merchant pada pop-up Konfirmasi Nama Pembayaran
  7. Input kolom ID Pelanggan pada pop-up Konfirmasi Nama Pembayaran dengan 10 digit nomor pembayaran yang terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 digit nomor PJJ
  8. Klik tombol Konfirmasi dan otomatis kembali ke halaman utama menu Multipayment
  9. Klik tombol Lanjut untuk proses pembentukan tagihan angsuran​​​​​​|
  10. Periksa data tagihan pada halaman konfirmasi transaksi, untuk total tagihan sudah termasuk dengan biaya admin
  11. Klik tombol Konfirmasi untuk proses pembayaran jika sudah benar dan sesuai
  12. Melakukan persetujuan transaksi melalui aplikasi m-Banking Livin by Mandiri
  13. Simpan bukti transaksi pembayaran melalui i-Banking sebagai bukti pembayaran angsuran yang sah
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the Bank Mandiri i-Banking website in a browser.
  2. Enter your User ID and Password, then click the Login button to log in to i-Banking.
  3. Select the Payment Menu - Multipayment.
  4. Click the Service Provider column and type the search term \"Payment Kita.\" The column displays the \"Payment Kita\" option. Click it, and \"Payment Kita\" will automatically populate.
  5. Click the Merchant Code column. The i-Banking page will automatically display the Payment Name Confirmation.
  6. Enter code 117 in the Merchant Code column in the Payment Name Confirmation pop-up.
  7. Enter the Customer ID column in the Payment Name Confirmation pop-up with the 10-digit payment number consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code and the 7-digit PJJ number.
  8. Click the Confirm button and you will automatically return to the main Multipayment menu page.
  9. Click the Continue button to create your installment bill.
  10. Check the billing details on the transaction confirmation page to ensure the total bill includes the admin fee.
  11. Click the Confirm button to process the payment if everything is correct and appropriate.
  12. Approve the transaction through the Livin by Mandiri m-Banking application.
  13. Save the proof of payment via i-Banking as valid proof of installment payment.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:28:48.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:34:33.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":39,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Online Payment (Aplikasi EZ For You)","EN":"ONLINE PAYMENT (Aplikasi EZ For You)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka Aplikasi EZ For You pada gawai dan login aplikasi
  2. Pilih nomor PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ) yang akan dilakukan pembayaran
  3. Pilih angsuran yang akan dibayar, klik Bayar
  4. Pilih metode pembayaran menggunakan QR Code
  5. Melakukan pembayaran menggunakan Rekening Bank atau E-Wallet dengan cara scan kode QR menggunakan kamera handphone atau proses pembayaran melalui foto QR di galeri (Total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  6. Simpan bukti bayar yang didapatkan dari pihak Bank/E-Wallet yang digunakan untuk pembayaran QRIS
  7. Setelah melakukan pembayaran, kembali ke aplikasi EZ For You dan lakukan konfirmasi pembayaran dengan klik “Konfirmasi”
  8. Muncul ringkasan sukses pembayaran dengan metode QRIS
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the EZ For You app on your device and log in.
  2. Select the distance learning (PJJ) number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit distance learning (PJJ) number) for which payment will be made.
  3. Select the installment to be paid, click Pay.
  4. Select the payment method using the QR Code.
  5. Make the payment using a bank account or e-wallet by scanning the QR code with your phone camera or by taking a photo of the QR code in your gallery. (The total bill includes the admin fee.)
  6. Save the proof of payment obtained from the bank/e-wallet used for the QRIS payment.
  7. After making the payment, return to the EZ For You app and confirm the payment by clicking \"Confirm.\"
  8. A summary of the successful QRIS payment will appear.
"},"costumer_information_type_id":3,"file_path":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"is_delete":false,"is_active":true,"created_at":"2025-11-08T13:29:59.000000Z","updated_at":"2026-08-05T01:34:18.000000Z","create_by":null,"update_by":null,"tagline":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"subtitle":{"ID":null,"EN":null},"template_type":{"id":16,"title":"Title Type 1 + Content","value":"TITLE_TYPE_1_CONTENT","type":"CUSTOMER_INFORMATION","is_delete":0,"is_active":1,"created_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","updated_at":"2025-10-15T20:23:12.000000Z","bg":null,"custom_css":null,"deleted_at":null},"items":[]},{"id":40,"parent_id":null,"template_type_id":16,"title":{"ID":"Online Payment (gojek)","EN":"ONLINE PAYMENT (gojek)"},"content":{"ID":"


Keterangan:

  1. Buka aplikasi Gojek pada gawai dan login kedalam aplikasi
  2. Pilih menu “Lainnya”
  3. Pilih menu “GoTagihan”
  4. Pilih “Multifinance”
  5. Pada kolom pencarian nama perusahaan pilih “Indomobil Finance Indonesia”
  6. Masukan Nomor Kontrak dengan no. PJJ (terdiri dari 3 digit kode cabang IMFI + 7 nomor PJJ) lalu pilih “Lanjut”
  7. Muncul informasi tagihan (total tagihan yang muncul sudah termasuk biaya admin)
  8. Pilih metode pembayaran yang akan digunakan lalu pilih “Bayar”
  9. Muncul tampilan halaman Resi Pembayaran sebagai bukti pembayaran yang sah dan bukti bayar dapat
","EN":"


Description:

  1. Open the Gojek app on your device and log in.
  2. Select the \"More\" menu.
  3. Select the \"GoTagihan\" menu.
  4. Select \"Multifinance.\"
  5. In the company name search field, select \"Indomobil Finance Indonesia.\"
  6. Enter the Contract Number with the PJJ number (consisting of the 3-digit IMFI branch code + the 7-digit PJJ number), then select \"Continue.\"
  7. Billing information will appear (the total bill includes the admin fee).
  8. Select the payment method you wish to use, then select \"Pay.\"
  9. The Payment Receipt page will appear as valid proof of payment.

PERPANJANGAN STNK OLEH KONSUMEN

Konsumen datang ke kantor cabang dengan membawa kartu angsuran atau bukti pembayaran terakhir ke kantor cabang, kemudian IMFI akan memberikan :

  1. Surat Keterangan dari IMFI untuk perpanjangan STNK
  2. Fotocopy BPKB (permintaan fotocopy BPKB sebaiknya 14 hari sebelum jatuh tempo STNK)
","EN":"
  • Original KTP / SIM / Passport that is still valid
  • Stamped power of attorney from the debtor (power of attorney) to a 3rd party (power of attorney) if the BPKB is taken by proxy accompanied by an original KTP in the name of the debtor and power of attorney.

","EN":"

You can visit this website to read information about the products and services we provide, General Information, and other information without revealing your identity.

You may be asked to provide your personal data for use as part of our services or for correspondence purposes (e.g., promotions, sending brochures and newsletters). This data, such as your name, address, email address, and other personal data, may be used by us and shared with our business partners to complement, add to, or improve our services to you. We will not sell or distribute consumer personal data to other companies for their own personal use.

If you use certain features on this website, such as the Application Form, Member Login, Survey, or Quiz, you may be asked to enter your personal data to verify your identity.

The data we obtain from the credit application process will not be shared with any other party, except to our appointed dealers or our business partners for the purpose of adding, adding, or improving our services to you. We may use this information to verify/investigate your identity, status, employment, and income to ensure the accuracy of such information in a manner deemed appropriate by PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia.

Cookies may be used to help collect statistical data. During your use and access of this website, IMFI may collect anonymous statistical data, such as information regarding the time and duration of your visit, the pages you access, the documents you download, and the date and time of your access.

Anda dapat mengunjungi website ini untuk membaca informasi tentang produk dan service yang kami berikan, Informasi Umum dan informasi lainnya tanpa memberitahukan identitas Anda.

Anda dapat diminta untuk memberikan data pribadi Anda untuk digunakan sebagai bagian dari pelayanan (service) kami atau untuk tujuan korespondensi (Contoh: promosi, pengiriman brosur dan newsletter). Data tersebut seperti, nama, alamat, email dan data pribadi lainnya, dapat digunakan oleh kami dan diberikan (shared) kepada mitra bisnis kami untuk melengkapi, menambah atau memperbaiki pelayanan (service) kami kepada Anda. Kami tidak akan menjual dan menyebarluaskan data pribadi konsumen kepada perusahaan lain untuk digunakan bagi kepentingan pribadi perusahaan tersebut.

Jika Anda menggunakan beberapa fitur dalam website ini, seperti Formulir Aplikasi, Login Anggota, Survey atau Quiz Anda dapat diminta untuk memasukkan data pribadi Anda guna membuktikan keabsahan identitas Anda.

Data yang kami dapat dari proses aplikasi kredit tidak akan disebarluaskan kepada pihak lain, kecuali kepada dealer yang kami tunjuk atau kepada mitra bisnis kami dengan tujuan menambah, melengkapi atau memperbaiki pelayanan (service) kami kepada Anda. Kami dapat menggunakan informasi ini untuk memeriksa / menyelidiki identitas, status, pekerjaan dan penghasilan Anda untuk memastikan kebenaran informasi tersebut dengan cara yang dianggap layak oleh PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia.

Cookies dapat digunakan untuk membantu mengumpulkan data statistik. Selama anda menggunakan dan mengakses website ini, IMFI dapat melakukan pengumpulan data statistik secara rahasia (anonymous), seperti informasi mengenai waktu dan lama Anda berkunjung, halaman yang Anda akses, dan dokumen yang Anda download, serta tanggal dan waktu Anda mengakses halaman.

","EN":"

You can visit this website to read information about the products and services we provide, General Information, and other information without revealing your identity.

You may be asked to provide your personal data for use as part of our services or for correspondence purposes (e.g., promotions, sending brochures and newsletters). This data, such as your name, address, email address, and other personal data, may be used by us and shared with our business partners to complement, add to, or improve our services to you. We will not sell or distribute consumer personal data to other companies for their own personal use.

If you use certain features on this website, such as the Application Form, Member Login, Survey, or Quiz, you may be asked to enter your personal data to verify your identity.

The data we obtain from the credit application process will not be shared with any other party, except to our appointed dealers or our business partners for the purpose of adding, adding, or improving our services to you. We may use this information to verify/investigate your identity, status, employment, and income to ensure the accuracy of such information in a manner deemed appropriate by PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia.

Cookies may be used to help collect statistical data. During your use and access of this website, IMFI may collect anonymous statistical data, such as information regarding the time and duration of your visit, the pages you access, the documents you download, and the date and time of your access.

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (\"Perseroan\") adalah perusahaan yang bergerak dalam bisnis jasa pembiayaan motor, mobil, kendaraan niaga, alat berat, mesin, properti, multiguna dan pembiayaan usaha mikro baik secara konvensional maupun syariah yang didirikan pada 1 November 1993. Perseroan berizin dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

 

Sebagaimana tercantum dalam Anggaran Dasar, Perseroan menjalankan kegiatan usaha pembiayaan, yaitu pembiayaan investasi, pembiayaan modal kerja, pembiayaan multiguna, sewa operasi dan pembiayaan syariah.

 

Perseroan merupakan bagian dari salah satu grup perusahaan otomotif terbesar di Indonesia, yaitu Grup Indomobil dengan kepemilikan saham sebesar 99,91% dimiliki oleh PT Indomobil Multi Jasa Tbk., sedangkan sisanya sebesar 0,09% dimiliki oleh PT IMG Sejahtera Langgeng.

 

Dalam perjalanannya, Perseroan telah banyak melakukan ekspansi bisnis, yaitu meluncurkan produk pembiayaan baru untuk sektor kendaraan komersial (2009), memperluas jangkauan layanan pembiayaan untuk, alat berat, mesin, dan lainnya (2010), mengembangkan produk di sektor jasa pembiayaan syariah melalui Unit Usaha Syariah (2012), membuka unit bisnis baru untuk pembiayaan properti (2015), dan terus berinovasi melalui teknologi digital, dengan meluncurkan aplikasi Microfinancing pada tahun 2017.

 

Selama lebih dari dua dekade, Perseroan mampu menjaga kelangsungan bisnisnya dengan tetap memanfaatkan sinergi yang solid dengan perusahaan-perusahaan lainnya yang tergabung dalam Grup Indomobil. Dengan didukung lebih dari 3.000 karyawan dan 242 jaringan layanan, Perseroan berhasil mempertahankan keunggulan dan reputasinya sebagai penyedia solusi pembiayaan yang andal dan terpercaya di Indonesia.

","EN":"

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (the \"Company\") is a company engaged in the financing services for motorcycles, cars, commercial vehicles, heavy equipment, machinery, property, multipurpose financing, and micro-enterprise financing, both conventionally and under Sharia principles. Established on November 1, 1993, the Company is licensed and supervised by Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK).


As stated in its Articles of Association, the Company operates financing businesses, including investment financing, working capital financing, multipurpose financing, operating leases, and Sharia financing.


The Company is part of one of Indonesia's largest automotive groups, the Indomobil Group. PT Indomobil Multi Jasa Tbk. owns 99.91% of its shares, while PT IMG Sejahtera Langgeng holds the remaining 0.09% stake.


Throughout its history, the Company has undertaken numerous business expansions, including launching new financing products for the commercial vehicle sector (2009), expanding its financing services for heavy equipment, machinery, and other vehicles (2010), developing products in the Sharia financing sector through its Sharia Business Unit (2012), opening a new business unit for property financing (2015), and continuing to innovate through digital technology, launching a Microfinancing application in 2017.


For more than two decades, the Company has maintained its business continuity by leveraging strong synergies with other companies within the Indomobil Group. Supported by more than 3,000 employees and 242 service networks, the Company has successfully maintained its excellence and reputation as a provider of reliable and trusted financing solutions in Indonesia.

Halo, Sahabat IMFI!

Mencari solusi pembiayaan kendaraan hingga modal usaha kini semakin praktis lewat aplikasi mobile, EZ For You, dari Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI). Hanya dalam satu genggaman, kamu bisa melakukan simulasi kredit, mengecek angsuran, hingga mengajukan pembiayaan kapan saja dan di mana saja.

Untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik, EZ For You kini hadir dengan pembaruan versi terbaru. Bagi kamu calon konsumen maupun pengguna setia, yuk simak deretan fitur baru dan alasan penting mengapa kamu wajib mengunduh atau memperbarui aplikasinya hari ini!

Apa Saja yang Baru di Aplikasi IMFI EZ For You?

Kami selalu mendengarkan kebutuhan kamu. Pada versi terbaru ini, IMFI EZ For You hadir dengan peningkatan performa serta berbagai fitur baru yang dirancang khusus untuk kenyamanan kamu:

1. Perkenalan Fitur Baru: Asisten Virtual \"Izzy\"

Bingung mau tanya-tanya soal simulasi kredit, tanggal jatuh tempo, atau syarat pengajuan? Sekarang kamu tidak perlu bingung lagi! Kenalkan Izzy, asisten virtual cerdas yang siap membantu menjawab berbagai pertanyaan kamu kapan saja.

Tidak hanya itu, jika kamu membutuhkan bantuan lebih lanjut, fitur Izzy juga dapat langsung terhubung secara praktis dengan tim Customer Service maupun Telemarketing IMFI. Mendapatkan informasi resmi dan penawaran terbaik kini serasa makin dekat dan responsif!

2. Konten Promo & Artikel Lengkap serta Informatif

Ingin berburu promo DP ringan, diskon angsuran, atau sekadar membaca tips-tips finansial dan otomotif terkini? Bagian Promo dan Artikel di aplikasi IMFI EZ For You kini telah diperbarui menjadi jauh lebih lengkap, rapi, dan informatif. Semua info penting yang kamu butuhkan tersaji secara jelas di satu tempat.

3. Notifikasi Otomatis: Selalu Up to Date

Jangan sampai ketinggalan penawaran menarik! Dengan memperbarui aplikasi ke versi terbaru, kamu akan langsung mendapatkan pemberitahuan (push notification) setiap kali ada promo spesial, program pembiayaan baru, maupun artikel menarik yang diterbitkan. kamu dipastikan selalu menjadi yang terdepan dalam menerima kabar dan kesempatan terbaik dari IMFI.

Penting bagi Pengguna Setia: Imbauan Pembaruan Data Pribadi

Bagi kamu konsumen aktif (existing) yang sudah setia menggunakan aplikasi IMFI EZ For You, kami mengimbau untuk dapat meluangkan waktu sejenak melengkapi dan memperbarui data pribadi di dalam profil aplikasi.

Pembaruan data ini sangat penting agar kami dapat memberikan layanan yang presisi, pengiriman dokumen yang tepat sasaran, serta kemudahan komunikasi terkait kontrak pembiayaan kamu.

Data yang Perlu Diperbarui Meliputi:

  • Nama Lengkap & Jelas (Sesuai dokumen identitas KTP)
  • Alamat Domisili Terkini
  • Nomor Telepon / WhatsApp Aktif
  • Alamat Email Aktif

Belum Punya atau Belum Update? Yuk, Lakukan Langkah Ini Sekarang!

Tunggu apa lagi? Nikmati kemudahan bertransaksi dan berkonsultasi pembiayaan hanya dalam satu aplikasi.

  • Customer baru: Unduh aplikasi IMFI EZ For You secara gratis melalui Google Play Store (Android) atau App Store (iOS).
  • Customer setia: Buka Play Store atau App Store di ponsel kamu, cari EZ For You, lalu tekan tombol Update ke versi paling baru.

Lakukan simulasi kreditnya, sapa asisten virtual Izzy, nikmati promonya, dan lengkapi data pribadi kamu sekarang juga!

Download aplikasi EZ For You di sini!

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia berizin dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Hello, IMFI Friends!

Finding financing solutions for vehicles and business capital is now more practical with EZ For You, the mobile app from Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI). Right at your fingertips, you can calculate financing simulations, check your installments, and apply for financing anytime, anywhere.

To provide you with an even better experience, EZ For You is now available with its latest version update. Whether you are a prospective customer or a loyal existing customer, let’s take a look at the new features and find out why you should download or update the app today!

What’s New in the IMFI EZ For You App?

We always listen to your needs. With the latest version, IMFI EZ For You comes with improved performance and various new features designed specifically for your convenience:

1. Introducing the New Virtual Assistant: “Izzy”

Confused about financing simulations, payment due dates, or application requirements? You don’t have to worry anymore! Meet Izzy, an intelligent virtual assistant ready to help answer your questions anytime.

That’s not all. If you need further assistance, Izzy can also connect you directly and conveniently with the IMFI Customer Service or Telemarketing team. Getting official information and the latest offers is now easier and more responsive than ever!

2. More Complete and Informative Promotional Content & Articles

Looking for low down payment promotions, installment discounts, or simply want to read the latest financial and automotive tips? The Promo and Articles sections in the IMFI EZ For You app have now been upgraded to provide more complete, organized, and informative content. All the important information you need is available clearly in one place.

3. Automatic Notifications: Always Stay Up to Date

Don’t miss out on exciting offers! By updating the app to the latest version, you will receive push notifications whenever there is a special promotion, new financing program, or interesting article. This ensures you are always among the first to receive the latest updates and opportunities from IMFI.

Important for Our Loyal Customers: Update Your Personal Information

For our active (existing) customers who have been using the IMFI EZ For You app, we encourage you to take a moment to complete and update your personal information in your app profile.

Keeping your information up to date is important so that we can provide more accurate services, ensure documents are delivered to the right address, and facilitate communication regarding your financing contract.

Personal Information to Update Includes:

  • Full and Accurate Name (as stated on your KTP/ID card)
  • Current Residential Address
  • Active Phone Number / WhatsApp Number
  • Active Email Address

Haven’t Downloaded or Updated the App Yet? Let’s Do It Now!

What are you waiting for? Enjoy a more convenient way to manage and explore financing services, all in one app.

  • New customers: Download the IMFI EZ For You app for free through the Google Play Store (Android) or App Store (iOS).
  • Existing customers: Open the Play Store or App Store on your phone, search for EZ For You, then tap Update to install the latest version.

Run your financing simulation, say hello to virtual assistant Izzy, enjoy the latest promotions, and update your personal information today!

Download the EZ For You app here!

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia is licensed and supervised by Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Halo, Sahabat IMFI!

Mengembangkan skala bisnis tentu membutuhkan perencanaan finansial yang matang dan aset operasional yang memadai. Baik perusahaan skala menengah maupun korporasi besar, ketersediaan armada kendaraan hingga alat berat sering kali menjadi kunci utama agar operasional harian berjalan optimal. Namun, mengalokasikan arus kas (cash flow) langsung untuk pembelian aset bernilai tinggi secara tunai tentu berisiko mengganggu fleksibilitas keuangan perusahaan.

Untuk menjaga kestabilan modal kerja sekaligus memenuhi kebutuhan ekspansi, solusi pembiayaan korporasi dari PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI) hadir sebagai jawaban yang tepat. IMFI menyediakan kemudahan akses pembiayaan yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan berbagai sektor industri di Indonesia.

Layanan Pembiayaan IMFI untuk Kendaraan dan Armada Perusahaan

Setiap bisnis memiliki kebutuhan operasional yang berbeda. IMFI merancang pembiayaan korporasi secara fleksibel agar dapat dimanfaatkan oleh berbagai jenis usaha, di antaranya:

  • Kendaraan Operasional Kantor (Fleet): Membantu perusahaan menyediakan armada kendaraan dinas bagi manajemen, eksekutif, maupun tim operasional lapangan untuk mendukung mobilitas harian.
  • Kendaraan Niaga dan Komersial: Pembiayaan untuk truk, pick-up, atau bus yang dibutuhkan oleh sektor logistik, ekspedisi, manufaktur, dan distribusi barang.
  • Alat Berat (Heavy Equipment): Pembiayaan unit alat berat seperti excavator, wheel loader, dan jenis lainnya bagi perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang konstruksi, pertambangan, perkebunan, dan kehutanan.

Dokumen Syarat Pengajuan Pembiayaan di IMFI bagi Perusahaan

Proses pengajuan pembiayaan di IMFI dirancang transparan dan efisien. Untuk mempercepat proses evaluasi dan persetujuan, pastikan perusahaan Anda telah melengkapi beberapa dokumen persyaratan berikut:

  1. Fotokopi KTP Direktur / Komisaris / Penerima Kuasa
  2. Fotokopi Akta Notaris Pendirian & Perubahannya
  3. Fotokopi NPWP Perusahaan
  4. Fotokopi SIUP / NIB
  5. Fotokopi TDP / NIB
  6. Fotokopi Rekening Koran 3 Bulan Terakhir
  7. Fotokopi Laporan Keuangan (Neraca & Laba Rugi)

Mengapa Memilih Pembiayaan di IMFI?

Sebagai bagian dari Indomobil Group, IMFI telah berpengalaman puluhan tahun dalam memberikan solusi pembiayaan terpercaya di Indonesia. Selain itu, pembiayaan di IMFI telah berizin dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK), sehingga transaksi aman dan profesional. Untuk Anda yang tertarik dengan pembiayaan dari IMFI, silakan klik link berikut ini!

[Klik di sini untuk konsultasi]

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia berizin dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Hello, IMFI Friends!

Growing a business requires careful financial planning and adequate operational assets. Whether you run a medium-sized company or a large corporation, having sufficient vehicle fleets and heavy equipment is often essential to ensure smooth and optimal daily operations. However, allocating cash flow directly toward high-value asset purchases can potentially reduce your company’s financial flexibility.

To maintain working capital stability while supporting business expansion, the corporate financing solutions offered by PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia (IMFI) can be the right answer. IMFI provides convenient access to financing tailored to the needs of various industries across Indonesia.

IMFI Financing Services for Various Business Sectors

Every business has different operational needs. IMFI offers flexible corporate financing solutions that can be utilized by various types of businesses, including:

  • Office Operational Vehicles (Fleet): Helping companies provide official vehicle fleets for management, executives, and field operation teams to support their daily mobility.
  • Commercial Vehicles: Financing for trucks, pick-ups, or buses required by businesses in the logistics, freight forwarding, manufacturing, and goods distribution sectors.
  • Heavy Equipment: Financing for heavy equipment such as excavators, wheel loaders, and other types of machinery for companies operating in the construction, mining, plantation, and forestry industries.

Financing Application Requirements at IMFI for Companies

The financing application process at IMFI is designed to be transparent and efficient. To help speed up the evaluation and approval process, make sure your company has prepared the following required documents:

  1. Photocopy of the ID Card (KTP) of the Director / Commissioner / Authorized Representative
  2. Photocopy of the Deed of Establishment and Amendments, certified by a Notary
  3. Photocopy of the Company Tax Identification Number (NPWP)
  4. Photocopy of the Business Identification Number (NIB) / Business License (SIUP)
  5. Photocopy of the Company Registration Certificate (TDP) / Business Identification Number (NIB)
  6. Photocopy of the Company’s Bank Statements for the Last 3 Months
  7. Photocopy of the Financial Statements (Balance Sheet & Income Statement)

Why Choose IMFI Financing?

As part of the Indomobil Group, IMFI has decades of experience in providing trusted financing solutions in Indonesia. In addition, IMFI is licensed and supervised by the Financial Services Authority (OJK), ensuring a safe and professional financing experience.

Interested in financing from IMFI? Click the link below for more information and consultation!

Click here for a consultation

PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia is licensed and supervised by Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Halo, Sahabat IMFI!

Industri pertambangan, konstruksi, hingga logistik di Indonesia terus mengalami perkembangan yang pesat. Bagi Anda para pelaku usaha yang ingin memperkuat armada operasional, menambah unit kargo modern, maupun memperbarui alat berat pendukung bisnis, ajang tahunan ini menjadi tempat yang tepat untuk menemukan kebutuhan usaha Anda. 

Mining Indonesia 2026 akan resmi digelar pada 9 - 12 September 2026 di JIExpo Kemayoran, Jakarta. Pameran berskala internasional ini menjadi momen emas untuk melihat langsung inovasi teknologi alat berat dan kendaraan niaga terkini sekaligus berburu unit operasional andalan.

Lini Unit Indomobil Group di Mining Indonesia 2026

Di Mining Indonesia, Anda dapat menemukan beragam lini unit tangguh dari brand di bawah Indomobil Group yang dirancang untuk produktivitas tinggi, efisiensi operasional, hingga transisi ke teknologi ramah lingkungan:

1. Alat Berat (Heavy Equipment)

  • Volvo Excavator 20T/30T: Tangguh, efisien bahan bakar, dan memiliki daya gali optimal untuk proyek skala menengah hingga besar.
  • Volvo SD Compactor: Pilihan tepat untuk pemadatan tanah dan jalan dengan hasil yang stabil serta tahan lama.
  • Volvo Dump Truck: Armada pengangkut material heavy-duty yang siap mendukung kelancaran logistik tambang Anda.

2. Kendaraan Niaga (Commercial Vehicle)

  • JAC UrbanMover N90EV SB dan LB: Truk listrik (Electric Vehicle) serbaguna yang ramah lingkungan, hemat energi, dan efisien untuk mendukung kebutuhan rantai pasok serta distribusi operasional bisnis Anda.

Program Penawaran Pembiayaan IMFI di Mining Indonesia

Mewujudkan peremajaan armada operasional kini semakin mudah dan fleksibel. Indomobil Finance (IMFI) hadir memberikan solusi pembiayaan khusus dengan penawaran menarik selama event Mining Indonesia:

Promo Alat Berat:

  • DP Ringan
  • Potongan Angsuran
  • Tenor hingga 3 Tahun

Promo Kendaraan Niaga:

  • Bunga 0% Tenor 1 Tahun: Khusus tipe Cargo - Logistics (SD Series, LD, MD Series, dan HDL).
  • DP Ringan Mulai dari 15%

Wujudkan Peremajaan Armada Bisnis Anda Sekarang!

Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk meningkatkan kapasitas serta daya saing bisnis Anda bersama mitra pembiayaan terpercaya.

Ingin tahu simulasi angsuran, konsultasi unit, atau syarat pengajuan pembiayaan? Tim kami siap membantu memberikan solusi terbaik sesuai skema kebutuhan usaha Anda.

Indomobil Group Unit Lineup at Mining Indonesia 2026
